question: Re-run scripts/mission_signals.py hiring on or after 2027-02-15 (same 12 employers, same regexes) and report the change in the share of open roles whose role-level text mentions AI/ML/LLM, split into build_ai and use_ai_tools, for sponsors vs DAF-core vendors vs broad nonprofit-tech vendors. question: Hand-code a random sample of 200 GDELT headlines (2021-2026) from the base donor-advised-fund query into the six themes (payout/reform, controversial grantees, crypto, AI, giving records, legislation) plus 'passing mention / not about DAFs', and estimate the precision of each full-text keyword theme filter used in daf-news-volume-2021-2026.csv
conclusion_affected: Validity of the theme shares in the news-volume series; whether 'record' and 'reform' filters over-count
rationale: GDELT DOC 2.0 matches keywords anywhere in the article text, so a theme hit can be incidental (a tax-tips article that mentions the IRS counts as legislation). Without a precision estimate, the theme shares can only be read as upper bounds
